capabilities: Export a canvas as a Word (.docx) document by following the arrows
Export a canvas as a PDF document that follows the arrows
Export a canvas as a drawn PDF preserving boxes, groups, colours, arrows and labels
Keep Markdown formatting, lists, callouts, tables, images and arrow labels in the output
Configure titles, headings, page numbers, output folder and save location
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community plugin list; installed via BRAT or manually. The as-drawn PDF export is desktop only, while the document export works on desktop and iOS/iPadOS. Runs fully locally with no network access or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian canvases are visual boards with no built-in way to export them as a Word or PDF document that preserves their content and layout.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from Community plugins.

summary: Canvas export plugin that turns a canvas into a Word (.docx) or PDF file, either as drawn or as running text that follows the arrows.
